A factorial design is used in vitro to test the interaction between the MDC (MINCH), the differentiation agent (rosiglitazone), and the inhibitor (GW9662). TPP data specifically uses a temperature gradient as an analytical tool to find interactors, but the biological variable remains the chemical treatment.
